title: Skin Changer
featureUpdate:
[h2]Update 1.0.33[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved synchronization of skin choices, character-select backgrounds, previews, portraits and in-run models.
[*]Improved CZN skin compatibility, Crusader combat animations, Joan of Arc variants and damage stages, and merchant/rest-site appearance switching. Fixed enlarged card artwork and Vakuu static-image backgrounds, including the alternate art branch.
[*]Added idle-time file prefetching with selected-skin priority and bounded resource caches. Startup timeout and exit safeguards are retained.
[/list]
description:
Switch character, card, monster, Ancient, merchant, creature, event and combat background skins, with previews in the Other Compendium.

[h1]NO RESTART! SWITCH AND USE INSTANTLY![/h1]

[h2]Details[/h2]
[list]
[*]Switch skins in character select and compendiums, or adjust appearance during a run.
[*]Organize your choices with priorities, presets, skin combinations and bundles.
[*]Browse the curated Workshop catalog and subscribe or unsubscribe in-game.
[*]Customizable themes and 15 interface languages.
[/list]

[h2]Important[/h2]
This update targets game v0.113.1. Compatibility with older branches has not been revalidated in this release.
Skins are subscribed separately. Skin Changer adjusts its load order and prompts for a restart when needed.

[h2]Limitations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Skins with special code, gameplay changes or custom managers may need compatibility work.
[*]Newly subscribed skins may need a restart; check their Workshop labels.
[/list]
